The Chinese characters for Henry

As a transliteration, Henry is usually written 亨利 (Hēng lì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

亨
Hēng
prosperous, smooth
利
lì
sharp, benefit

Origin and meaning

With Germanic origins, Henry is usually read as “home ruler”.

About the name Henry

The name of eight English kings and of the industrialist Henry Ford.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “home ruler”, a Henry calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
